location: 矮人矿山 · 皇家宫殿 / 皇家寝宫
note: 守在皇家区域各处的卫兵,只有路过时的闲聊,没有任务线。和 Castle_Guards.json 是不同的 NPC 名字。

messages.raw: §fWatch yourself, traveler. There are creatures about.
messages.text: Watch yourself, traveler. There are creatures about.
messages.zh: 当心点,旅人。这附近有东西在游荡。

messages.context: 看到玩家已经解锁山峦之心时的招呼
messages.raw: §fBehold a fellow holder of Heart of the Mountain!
messages.text: Behold a fellow holder of Heart of the Mountain!
messages.gloss: Heart of the Mountain 已确定译“山峦之心”,见 GLOSSARY.md。
messages.zh: 瞧啊,又一位持有山峦之心的同道!

messages.context: 玩家靠得太近时的呵斥

messages.raw: §fGreat treasures lie ahead, but at what cost?
messages.text: Great treasures lie ahead, but at what cost?
messages.zh: 前方有无尽的宝藏,可代价又是什么呢?

messages.raw: §fThere are no miners like the dwarves.
messages.text: There are no miners like the dwarves.
messages.zh: 论挖矿,没人比得上矮人。
